$why: THE BROWNFIELD VARIANT OF THE SPEC PASS. Resolved by variantIdFor when EPAM_BROWNFIELD=1;
greenfield reads spec-agent-openspec.json and is untouched by this file existing.
WHY IT EXISTS. On a brownfield ticket the spec pass output is consumed as verification
criteria, fix-site analysis and technical notes. Acceptance criteria are NOT consumed — the
runner discards them on arrival, logging "brownfield — ignoring 8 AC(s) speckit produced;
ACs are out of scope" and "ACs are immutable (VC model); openspec AC edits redacted"
(live 2026-09-08, AMSD-1919). The greenfield template asks for them anyway, so the agent
spent output tokens — the dearest kind — producing a deliverable policy guarantees to bin.
THE PROMPT AND THE SCHEMA MUST AGREE. specAgentContract() removes the AC fields from the
tool under the same flag. Asking for a field the tool will not accept produces a refused
call and a retry, so the two are asserted to match by
IDENTICAL PLACEHOLDERS TO THE BASE, deliberately: the renderer supplies the same seventeen
named blocks either way, so switching variant cannot fail on a token nobody computed.

description: Produce or revise the specification for one story on a BROWNFIELD ticket, as the openspec agent.
$whyMayBeEmpty: Declared 2026-08-27 after run 20260827T125654Z aborted here. Each of these is a CONDITIONAL INSERT: the story is not being split, no earlier pass left gaps, no documentation was fetched, no contract has been published yet and attempt one carries no forced-retry note. The renderer's own rule is that absence must be a real state rather than a failed lookup — and a first pass having no prior gaps is exactly that. All ten rendered empty during normal operation and the render refused, three times per story, with no model involved; both lanes halted at the specification pass. __FIX_SITE_BLOCK__ is the one to watch: empty is legitimate before discovery has run, but it is ALSO what an unavailable code-graph-detective produces, and that failure is reported separately rather than inferred from this blank.
